product_metadata.title: Annual Christmas Photo Ornament - Set of 3 - Dated 2023 Silver Charm and Metal Snowflake Decoration with Crystals and Pearls - Family Wedding Vacation Pictures - Gift/Storage Bag Included
features: 2023 SNOWFLAKE PHOTO ORNAMENT. Beautiful dated filigree snowflake design adorned with crystals, beads, and pearls. Perfect lightweight Christmas ornament to display a family photo in, picture of your grandchildren or new baby.
SET OF 3 HOLIDAY ORNAMENTS. The metal ornament has fun snowflake trim to blend in with your other ornaments and designs.
SNOWFLAKE DECORATIONS. Make the season more special with this Metal Snowflake Photo Ornament.
SILVER SNOWFLAKE. This is a the perfect Xmas ornament to display wonderful family memories. Approximate measurements are 6" H x 3.5" W. Holds a 1.5" diameter photo. Comes gift boxed.
GIFT/STORAGE BAG INCLUDED. Ornament includes a red bag for gifting or storage.

description: Set of 3 2023 annual Christmas ornaments. Measures approximately 6" H x 3.5" W. Holds a 1.5" diameter photo. Decorative scroll hook included. Ornament is boxed and includes a gift/storage bag.
